question: Related Questions Q. How to pay the zakah of previous years? 2122 views Q. I have a question regarding charity as I am a reverted Muslim. Can I give charity to kafir 1890 views Q. Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahe wa Barakatuhu. Someone has sold his only dwelling house in order to procure money for purchasing a land/ house in some other place where he could live or could make a business. But he could not find a suitable one immediately after posssessing the money. More than a year has already been spent and he had not invested the money anywhere else. Please tell me whether he has to offer Zakah on this amount of money also. 1438 views Q. Zaakat is pending for around 30 years for Jwellery of my mother. Now we want to pay Zaakat now. Please let us know whether we have to pay zaakt of jwellery ,which is of gold and silver, of current price or we can calculate zaakat on the basis of old prices of gold and silver? 1857 views Q. Zakah on plots 1636 views Q. Is zakat wajib on a student getting scholarship? 4790 views Q. My wife has 240 grams of gold jewellery which she got it as gift from her mother at the time of marriage. Assalamualaikum Q)Many Musafir Safeers (who dont have money on them according to nisaab) collect donations on behalf of Islamic Schools or Madrasahs,when they are given zakaat money for the School or Madrasah they take Qabza of the money on behalf of the School or Madrasah (because they havn't got money according to nisaab)then they put all the money which was given to them as zakaat in to lillah for the School or Madrasah,In the above situation will the zakaat money become lillah? Note:Please reply as soon as possible.Jazakumullah 1863 views Q. We intend to pay zakah of our goods purchased for sale 2291 views Q. Zakah 1409 views Q. I am a Pakistani doctor working in Saudi Arabia. I donot have any house. I have about 6000 US dollars as saving and about 300 grams gold. I have purchased a piece of land for construction of my house. I also have some (3) pieces of land (PLOTS) for construction of small houses. My plan is to give these small pieces of land to my children, especially daughters (I donot have any plan to sell them at this moment). I am finding it difficult to calculate Zakat for me. Should I pay zakat on these small pieces of land which are not for sale? (Not for business). Kindly help me in calculation of zakat. 2045 views Q. Can one pay zakah in installments? 4072 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 153346 Country: INDIA Title: Zakat on recurring deposit (RD) Question: Opened a recurring deposit account (RD) to deposit a fixed amount every month (eg Rs 1000). After the end 12 months, how much the amount has to given for zakah? Answer ID: 153346 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1267/1276/H=12/1438) You will have to pay 300 rupees as zakah on 12000 rupees. However, zakah is paid as per lunar calendar. Thus, mark the day of the lunar date on which you became sahib-e-nisab and pay your zakah on the same date each year. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
